key_insight: Ghost tasking adds auxiliary output tasks so parametrized Gaussian Processes can be built even for systems that are not naturally parametrizable.
engineering_relevance: This makes physics-informed GP models more broadly usable for inverse and data-scarce differential-equation problems without requiring many outputs or latent functions.
method: Introduce auxiliary "ghost" tasks to reformulate a non-parametrizable linear differential system.
Use the augmented system to construct parametrizations algorithmically for Gaussian Processes.
Provide computer-algebra syntax for polynomial, rational, and meromorphic coefficient cases.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports three experiments with systematic comparisons to the only other method applicable across all cases, and highlights especially strong performance in inverse problems with very little data.
watch_item: The approach depends on symbolic parametrization machinery and computer-algebra support, which may add implementation complexity for practical pipelines.
paper_title: Ghost tasking for parametrized Gaussian Processes solving linear differential equations
